title: Teen shooter kills 3 children, teacher in Oregon elementary school before being shot by bystander - CNN
description: Three children and a teacher were killed in Bend, Oregon, when a 16-year-old entered an elementary school. Follow for live updates.

title: Dodgers tip cap to Brewers as title reign ends in NLCS sweep - ESPN
description: The Dodgers' quest for a three-peat ended Wednesday night in a 6-4 loss to the Brewers, who defeated them so thoroughly in the NLCS that it left L.A. with little to second-guess.

title: Megadonors are powering Republicans’ spending advantage - Politico
description: New FEC filings shed light on how a small group of donors, mostly on the Republican side, have driven record super PAC spending this cycle.

title: Katie Zacharia confirms she didn’t pass the bar exam - The Washington Post
description: The acknowledgment comes after days of uncertainty about the White House press secretary’s legal credentials.

title: Fed's Warsh withholds Fed rate signal, praises recent global tightening with 'no free riders' - CNBC
description: Warsh refrained from signaling another interest rate hike this month, pointed to a "synchronous tightening" by central banks in the fight against inflation.
